html:
Walking into a cannabis dispensary for the first time can feel like entering a category where everyone else already knows the vocabulary. They do not. You are allowed to ask basic questions, take your time, and say when you do not know what you want.

Shop BUZZY’s Brooklyn cannabis menu →

A good licensed dispensary should make cannabis easier to understand, not turn it into a test.

Step one: bring valid ID

Adult-use cannabis in New York is for people 21 and older. Licensed dispensaries must verify age, so bring a valid form of government-issued identification that shows your age and photo.

Step two: make sure the store is licensed

Look for New York’s official Dispensary Verification Tool near the entrance or check through the Office of Cannabis Management’s licensed dispensary locator. Licensed retailers sell regulated products that are subject to New York’s testing and labeling requirements.

You do not need to know what strain you want

Instead of starting with a strain name, it is often easier to start with how you like to consume cannabis. Do you prefer flower? A ready-to-use pre-roll? An edible? A beverage? A vape? Something you can portion into smaller servings?

From there, staff can help you compare products based on potency, format, flavor and aroma, cannabinoid content, terpene information where available, brand, price, and the type of experience the product is designed to fit.

Do not shop by THC alone

The highest THC number is not automatically the ‘best’ product. Cannabis is more nuanced than a single percentage. Format, serving size, terpene profile, cannabinoid mix, and your own tolerance all matter. A lower-potency product may be a much better fit for what you actually want.

Questions worth asking

Try questions like: What is the serving size? How much THC is in one serving versus the whole package? Is this flower more focused on aroma and terpene expression or sheer potency? Is this pre-roll infused or non-infused? What is the difference between these two vape formats? What products do you have in a smaller or more approachable potency range?

Understanding the main product categories

Flower is loose cannabis intended to be smoked or vaporized with appropriate equipment. Pre-rolls are ready-made joints and may be infused or non-infused. Edibles are foods or confections containing cannabis and can take longer to be felt than inhaled products. Beverages are drinkable cannabis products with serving information on the label. Vapes use cannabis oil or extracts in cartridge or all-in-one formats. Concentrates are extracted cannabis products that can vary significantly in texture, potency, and method of use.

Read the label before you leave

New York regulated products include potency and labeling information plus a QR code or link to a Certificate of Analysis. For edibles and beverages especially, distinguish between THC per serving and THC in the entire package.

Plan for consumption before you buy

Remember that legal purchase does not mean legal consumption everywhere. NYC prohibits smoking and vaping in many public spaces, including parks, beaches, restaurants and outdoor dining areas. Never consume cannabis in a vehicle or drive impaired.

A neighborhood dispensary should feel approachable

At BUZZY, we built the experience around curation rather than overload. If it is your first visit, tell us. If you have tried cannabis before but do not know current New York brands, tell us that too. If you only know what you did not like last time, that is useful information.

The goal is not to sound like an expert. It is to leave with a product you understand.

For adults 21+. This article is educational and does not provide medical advice. Effects vary by person and product; start with label directions and use responsibly.
